text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was training with the members of 
'Project L'Arc' in the VR Umalator today, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah? Can't you tell just by lookin'? It's 
Golshi Collection, Gol-Colle!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Sei!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship's outfit changed in an instant. 
She seems to be enjoying the VR features 
to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, go change your clothes too.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so humble! Let's swing for the 
fences even harder, yeah!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"If you're aimin' to be number one in the 
world, goin' all-out crazy and doing 
whatever the hell you want is way more 
hype, ain't it?!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I got carried off by Gold Ship! And 
this is... inside the racetrack course?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's go~!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yahoooo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite our hopes, Gold Ship doesn't stop! 
Entering the slope of the third corner, 
she gradually picks up speed—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes, here it comes, here it 
coooomes!
choice_data_list: Speed! Ease up on the speed, please!
Speed! Ease up on the speed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her speed is intimidating, but an "End 
Closer" style that sweeps from the third 
corner drains a runner's stamina.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The strain on Gold Ship must be immense. 
She could be exhausted before the run is 
even over, and in the worst case, it might 
even carry over into tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whooooo! The wiiiiiiind~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, Gold Ship slowly... and gently, 
so as not to hurt me... ......dropped me 
to the ground.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"My buttocks ache a little, but the sight 
Gold Ship showed me was truly 
fascinating."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Conventional wisdom at the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe favors front-runners. Yet with 
a style uniquely her own, completely 
defying that norm, Gold Ship—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So, what kind of running do you guys do?
choice_data_list: Is that in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Squid tentacles!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship grins testingly, as if asking 
whether I plan to run strictly by the 
book.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's battle it out in the Rep 
Exchange Race! It's the final showdown 
between me and you guys!!
choice_data_list:
The end!? The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is 
still beyond that!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Forget stability, let's ride the rough 
waves!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"If you wanna beat me before it's over, 
you've only got one shot left★"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Try your best to win, okay~? Later gator~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I can't fully decipher what Gold Ship 
is trying to get at with that remark."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet the next showdown with Gold Ship would 
be the last. I had a feeling she wasn't 
just bluffing.
